# Bootstrap — Copilot VS Code native execution

These instructions apply when **Copilot** is the active session harness. Bootstrap setup is performed by the environment/setup agent; Copilot project agent contracts are in `.github/agents/` and registered native hooks in `.github/hooks/`. Selecting a Codex/Claude model in Copilot does not activate the Codex/Claude harness.

**First-time setup:** follow `docs/FOR_AI.md`; collect genuinely missing configuration through the IDE's native controls, without treating a permission dialog as requirements. The portable installer is only setup stage one. For Copilot, use `--runtime generic --target-app copilot` and confirm `.github/agents/planner.agent.md`, `.github/agents/advisor.agent.md`, and `.github/hooks/bootstrap-criteria.json` are installed and recognized. Do not report complete merely because files were copied; test one actual hook invocation and one blocked Criteria edit in a disposable workspace. Preserve all existing user configuration and reconcile collisions explicitly.

**Planning workflow:** choose native **Planner** for theory work. Initial Criteria must be drafted and displayed **in chat**; do not write `docs/CRITERIA.md` to prepare the draft. Brainstorm and agree scope without Advisor. Only after Human says to write the chat draft, invoke **Technical Advisor** on the exact full text, show its advice, obtain a NEW Human decision, then request the write. For an existing Criteria, discuss feature changes and settle a readable delta in chat; the Human's request to update triggers Advisor consultation before any file write. Human decides after advice. Advisor is advisory, never a veto, reviewer or approver.

**Hook behavior:** a `preToolUse` hook denies directly named Criteria edits without a current post-advice receipt and asks the agent to call Advisor. A valid receipt turns the decision into **ask**, not automatic approval: Human must inspect the actual edit in the VS Code native permission UI. The receipt is not independent evidence; neither the hook nor prompt can guarantee interception of all terminal/MCP writes or authenticate a Human. Never claim otherwise. See `.github/README.md`.

**Fail safely:** if Advisor is unavailable, post-advice Human decision is missing, or the hook is not verified to execute in the selected harness, do not automatically edit Criteria. Preserve project-owned files. Read `.agents/skills/challenge-feasibility/SKILL.md` for new ideas and `.agents/skills/write-criteria/SKILL.md` for human-readable Criteria synthesis.
